page.overview:
What is Dilburg Mine?

Dilburg Mine is a location in Final Fantasy Brave Exvius. It can be found on the eastern wasteland of the Dirnado mainland, above Maranda Coast, near Town of Kolts. Dilburg Mine shares its world icon and battle background (or "battlefield") with Ballen Passage.

After exiting the Town of Kolts, the party passes through the mine and arrive at Galebreak as they make their way to the Wind Shrine, hoping to prevent Veritas of the Heavens from destroying the Wind Crystal.
